text: Overhead view of a lab bench area. Centre: a black control pendant/handheld unit with multiple knobs, a red-orange mushroom emergency-stop button, a teal button, and a black-and-white ArUco marker, mounted on white 3D-printed brackets atop an aluminium extrusion rail. Behind it stands a white cylindrical device with a grey dial and small display, upright. A white power strip with a white cable lies on the bench at right; black and grey cables run across the floor and bench. Right background: blue machine housing, a black vertical column with clamps, and grey aluminium profile rails. Lower left: white trays or panels with grey stains and a white cup. Large white wall/panel fills the left side.
